title: Handle once, then die
summary: A handler can put the default action back with SIG_DFL.
hints: In the child, the handler does `write(...)` of `first` and then `signal(SIGINT, SIG_DFL);`. The second `raise(SIGINT)` then finds the default action: it ends the process.
The parent can tell with `WIFEXITED(status)`: a child killed by a signal did not exit normally.
